# Draft:Battle Of Aragvi Pass

The Battle of Aragvi Pass (1228) was an engagement during the Georgian–Khwarazmian wars fought in the mountainous Aragvi Valley of the Kingdom of Georgia. During the campaign of 1228, forces of Jalal ad-Din attempted to penetrate the Georgian highlands through the Aragvi corridor.
Georgian defenders used the narrow mountain passes and difficult terrain to ambush Khwarazmian forces attempting to move north through the valley.
Aftermath
The fighting in the Aragvi region weakened Khwarazmian operations in northern Georgia and forced Jalal ad-Din's forces to withdraw toward Armenia and Azerbaijan where further campaigns continued.
